class Solution:
    def minOperations(self, queries: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        def f(x: int) -> int:
            res = 0
            p = i = 1
            while p <= x:
                cnt = min(p * 4 - 1, x) - p + 1
                res += cnt * i
                i += 1
                p *= 4
            return res

        ans = 0
        for l, r in queries:
            s = f(r) - f(l - 1)
            mx = f(r) - f(r - 1)
            ans += max((s + 1) // 2, mx)
        return ans
